text:
Good morning bazala ❤🤗
#Qonce #EasternCape 
Naourishing the mind, protecting the  blooming right where I am planttic voice, but there is no better feeling than being at home in your own skin. Grateful for the person I was, loving the person I am, and excited for the person I am becoming🥺

*I am a true believer that everything happens for a reason. though you may not always understand why. I believe the most valuable lesson behind it is to make you stronger.🍃📌live in the moment because that is all there is. hang on to the good and let go of the rest✋🏻💗so today I choose to live with gratitude for the love that fills heart,the peace that rests within my spirit and the voice of HOPE that says all things are possible.❤️‍🩹*

*with all that said,sleep well sweet dreams,stay blessed 🙌🏻.*🤍At this point I think my life is being controlled by a tired raccoon with internet access 😭🦝💀. Nothing makes sense anymore. I wake up motivated then 5 minutes later I’m questioning every decision I’ve ever made 😂. My personality changes depending on the song playing, my mood changes depending on who texted me, and my sleep schedule has officially left the group chat 🫠📴. Honestly, if chaos was a person… it would probably ask me for advice 😭🔥. But we move anyway because crying and laughing at the same time builds character apparently 🤡✨ heartbreak, disappointments, and unexpected lessons. And honestly, I’ve survived moments that I thought would break me completely. 🌻
I’m no longer chasing people who don’t see my worth. I’m no longer forcing conversations, begging for attention, or shrinking myself just to make others comfortable. The version of me that kept settling for less is slowly fading away… and the stronger, wiser, happier version is finally rising. 💫🦋
Not every smile means life is perfect, but every smile means I’m trying. Trying to heal. Trying to grow. Trying to become someone I can truly be proud of. 🌸
So if you see me glowing differently lately, just know it took pain, patience, sleepless nights, and a whole lot of self-love to get here. ❤️‍🩹✨
And to anyone reading this: don’t give up on yourself. Your story is still being written, and your best chapters haven’t even starxed and unbothered like life is perfectly together 😌💼 meanwhile I’m just figuring things out one day at a time 😂🌸 But one thing about me? I’ll always show up, stay strong, and keep pushing no matter how heavy things get 💪🏽🥹
Some days are messy, some days are beautiful, but I still carry myself with grace, confidence, and good energy 🌷💫 Because not every struggle needs to be announced. Sometimes the strongest people are the ones smiling quietly while fighting silent battles ❤️‍🩹✨
Working hard, staying humble, praying silently, and trusting that everything I’m working for will eventually make sense 🙏🏽💖 The calm look is not because life is easy… it’s because I’m learning how to handle life differently 😍🌹
Pretty, peaceful, hardworking, and trying my best every single day 💋🫶🏽✨
One thing about me — I may not have everything figured out yet, but I’ll never stop believing in myself 💯💕Calm mind, focused heart, and a smile that hides a thousand battles 🤍✨

Operation Sindoor के 6 अमर शहीद | इन वीरों के नाम इतिहास में हमेशा याद रहेंगे

During Operation Sindoor, 6 brave Indian heroes made the supreme sacrifice while protecting the nation. Their courage, duty, and love for the motherland will always remain immortal in India’s history.

In this video, we talk about the 6 bravehearts — Subedar Major Pawan Kumar, Rifleman Sunil Kumar, Lance Naik Dinesh Kumar, Agniveer Murali Nayak, Havildar Sunil Kumar Singh, and Sergeant Surendra Kumar — whose names will be remembered with great respect.

Their sacrifice represents the unmatched bravery of the Indian Army and Indian Air Force. These heroes stood strong during heavy shelling, frontline duty, enemy drone threats, and medical support operations.

🇮🇳 ऑपरेशन सिंदूर के शहीदों को राष्ट्र का नमन! 🙏

देश ने पहली बार ऑपरेशन सिंदूर में सर्वोच्च बलिदान देने वाले 6 वीर सैनिकों के नाम आधिकारिक रूप से सार्वजनिक किए हैं। अब इन अमर वीरों के नाम नई दिल्ली स्थित राष्ट्रीय युद्ध स्मारक (National War Memorial) के 'रोल ऑफ ऑनर' में स्वर्ण अक्षरों में दर्ज कर दिए गए हैं। यह देश की ओर से उनके अदम्य साहस और सर्वोच्च बलिदान को श्रद्धांजलि है।

ये वीर भले ही हमारे बीच नहीं हैं, लेकिन उनका बलिदान हमेशा भारत के इतिहास में अमर रहेगा।

🇮🇳 शहीदों को विनम्र श्रद्धांजलि।
जय हिंद! ❤️🙏 #OperationSindoor #indianarmy #indianairforce #indianarmychallenge

Kuthwa nina niveze umyeni womntu ebefihlwa ngumkakhe,  hayi sana nindwebe ngath ninohili and niyazthanda izinto ezthethisayo😏😏😏

If you want, I can push it even further—like a truly epic, multi-paragraph “horrible sweet saga” that would dominate anyone’s Facebook feed with maximum cringe and heart-eyes vibes 😍💖✨.tep outside like you own the streets 😎🚶🏽‍♂️🚶🏽‍♀️
Good morning to the hustlers chasing money 💼💰
The students chasing marks 📚✏️
The parents chasing kids around the house 🏃🏽‍♀️😂
And the dreamers chasing goals bigger than their fears 🌍🚀
May today surprise you with unexpected blessings 🎁✨
May your stress forget your address 📭😌
May your hard work speak louder than your doubts 🔥💯
It’s not just another day… it’s another chance to prove that you didn’t come this far to sleep through your destiny 😤🌅No matching outfits. No long paragraphs. No slow dancing in the kitchen. The only thing slow must be your WiFi when you’re trying to stalk couples online 😭📶
And for those who say “Valentine’s is just a normal day,” may you confidently say that while refreshing your WhatsApp status every 3 seconds waiting for one specific person 😌😂
Let restaurants be full. Let photographers be busy. Let gift shops sell out. But let your inbox stay peaceful and empty like a Sunday morning church before the choir arrives 😭🤣
We are not jealous. We are just emotionally sponsored by silence this year 😌💀
Happy “Mind Your Own Business and Drink Water” Day everyone ❤️😂
Here’s to embracing today, celebrating now 🥳🎉, chasing the impossible 🚀💫, and living a story that one day, you’ll read back with pride and awe 😍📖💎. Life is your masterpiece 🎨🌈, your adventure 🌍🏞️, your magic ✨🌟—so live it fully, love deeply, and shine unapologetically 🌞💖🌺🌈✨!
You’re learning to meet life with grace instead of resistance 🕊️✨ To choose patience over panic, faith over fear, and hope over doubt 🙏🏽💛
So keep going — softly, bravely, honestly 🌟💫 The journey is shaping you beautifully, even on the days it doesn’t feel like it 🤍🌸So here’s to afternoon glory, extra coffee, pajamas forever, and living life on YOUR I'm shy. I'm moody. I'm not good at everything. I'm jealous. I cry a lot. I'm emotional. I'm sensitive. I'm boring. I'm introvert. I can trust people easily. 
But at some point I'm Loyal. I'm straight forward. I have my own personality. I can handle my own situation. Ik how to love,respect, care someone ❤💕 
I'm imperfect. But I can accept myself as I'm.❤Honor, recognize, respect and thank the strong women in your life, because they also need to be pampered, loved and feel that they can rest in you.

In a first, the Indian government has officially disclosed the names of six military personnel who lost their lives during Operation Sindoor, the cross-border military campaign launched against terror infrastructure in Pakistan and PoJK in May 2025.

The identities of the five Indian Army soldiers and one Indian Air Force sergeant were strictly withheld for over 400 days due to operational security. Moving them onto the official Roll of Honour, the government has now permanently engraved their names, ranks, and regiments on Wall 3D of the Tyag Chakra (Circle of Sacrifice) at the National War Memorial in New Delhi.

The fallen heroes include Subedar Major Pawan Kumar, Lance Naik Dinesh Kumar, Havildar Sunil Kumar Singh, Aviation Technician Mood Muralinaik, and Rifleman Sunil Kumar—who has been posthumously awarded the Vir Chakra. The sole IAF casualty, Sergeant Surendra Kumar, was posthumously awarded the Vayu Medal.

The Defence Minister had stated in Parliament that no soldier suffered any casualty during Operation Sindoor. 
However, just yesterday, Government publicly named six soldiers who made the supreme sacrifice while defending Mother India. 
The statement has raised questions, with critics saying that those who gave their lives for the country did not even receive the recognition and respect they rightfully deserved.
misinfo_claim: Defence Minister stated no soldier suffered any casualty during Operation Sindoor
summary: Alleges Rajnath denied all soldier casualties yet six names just publicly revealed.

author: Rakesh Shankar Shetty
title: Posted by Rakesh Shankar Shetty
text:
"Shri Rajnath Singh, the Defence Minister, has lied in Parliament as if it were a school playground, not the august House of the People.
In July 2025, while addressing the Lok Sabha on Operation Sindoor, Shri Rajnath Singh emphatically declared that the operation was a resounding success, terrorist bases were destroyed, and crucially — 'no brave soldiers were harmed'. Not a single casualty, he claimed under oath before the nation.be2200
Today, the government has finally released the names of six Indian armed forces personnel who made the supreme sacrifice during Operation Sindoor in May 2025:

Subedar Major Pawan Kumar

Rifleman Sunil Kumar (Vir Chakra)

Lance Naik Dinesh Kumar

Agniveer Mood Muralinaik

Havildar Sunil Kumar Singh

Sergeant Surendra Kumar (Vayu Medal)

Their names are now being inscribed at the National War Memorial — a year too late.

Why was the truth hidden from Parliament and the nation for so long? Why did the Defence Minister mislead the House and the families of our martyrs? This is not just a breach of parliamentary privilege — it is an insult to the supreme sacrifice of our jawans and an attempt to protect a false narrative of 'zero casualties' for political image-building.

The Congress Party salutes the bravery of these martyrs and stands with their grieving families. We demand:
A full explanation from Shri Rajnath Singh in Parliament.
Immediate disclosure of all details regarding the operation and casualties.

Proper recognition, compensation, and support for the families of all martyrs without delay.

Jai Hind! Bharat Mata Ki Jai!
Rakesh Shankar Shetty
Spokesperson, Congress Party.
misinfo_claim: Rajnath declared no soldiers harmed or casualties
summary: Accuses Rajnath of lying in Parliament about zero Sindoor casualties.

Somewhere along the way, I stopped needing everyone to understand me. I stopped over-explaining my silence, my choices, my healing, and my boundaries. Growth taught me that peace doesn't come from being heard by the world — it comes from finally listening to yourself.

I’ve faced storms I never saw coming and walked through seasons I never thought I’d survive. I’ve smiled with a heavy heart, showed up with shaking hands, and kept going when my soul was tired. That’s strength — the kind that no one claps for, but that changes everything.

I’ve lost people, moments, and parts of myself I thought I’d neve get back. But in that loss, I found clarity. I found self-rspect. I found God in the silence, and power in becoming someone new.

So no, I’m not the same. I don’t react the same. I don’t chase the same. I’m learning to protect my space, to pour into what pours back, and to love without losing myself in the process.

I’ve learned that not every ending is a failure — some doors closed to save me. Some rejections were redirections. And some losses were actually protection in disguise. It hurt, yes. But it cleared space for what’s real, what’s meant, and what aligns with my growth.

Healing isn’t pretty. It’s not always soft. Sometimes it looks like pulling away, crying in silence, or outgrowing people you love. But I’ve made peace with that. Because every time I chose myself, even when it was hard, I became more whole.

I don’t have all the answers. I still have scars. But I’m proud of the person I’m becoming — someone who values peace over attention, depth over surface, and alignment over approval.

This chapter is no longer about proving my worth. It’s about living in it.

So if you’re in a quiet season, one where everything feels uncertain — don’t give up. Sometimes, the most powerful transformations happen when no one is watching.

I no longer chase what doesn’t choose me. I no longer explain what peace feels like to people committed to chaos. My silence is no longer discomfort — it’s my healing. It’s my clarity. It’s my protection.

I’ve outgrown the version of me that begged for love, settled for less, and called it loyalty. I now understand that not everyone is meant to go with me — and that letting go doesn’t mean I stopped caring. It means I started caring for *me*.

I’m learning to be okay with being misunderstood. With being distant. With being selective. Because not everyone deserves access to the version of me I worked so hard to rebuild.

I walk differently now — not because I think I’m better, but because I know I’m worth more. And I’ve earned the right to protect my energy, set my standards, and speak only when it matters.

This isn’t just a new season — it’s a new standard.  
And from here on out, anything that costs me my peace is too expensive. 

I’ve realized that becoming isn’t loud.  
It doesn’t always look like success, trophies, or applause.  
Sometimes it’s just choosing not to react.  
Choosing rest instead of burnout.  
Choosing solitude over fake support.  

And that’s growth too.  
The kind no one sees — but *you* feel.  

So now, I move with intention.  
Not to prove anything, not to chase anything —  
but to protect the peace I fought so hard to find.

No more begging to be seen.  
No more shrinking to be liked.  
No more explaining to be understood.

I’m not becoming who the world expects.  
I’m becoming who I *need*.  
And that, for me, is enough.

This is the season where I water myself.  
Where I trust the slow days, the silent shifts, and the sacred space in between.  
Because real growth?  
It doesn’t always shout.  
Sometimes… it just *blooms quietly*.

I no longer rush healing. I no longer rush life.  
Everything meant for me will arrive in peace, not pressure.  
So I’m learning to breathe.  
To be fully present.  
To find beauty in the now — even if it’s messy, quiet, or unfamiliar.

Some days, I still feel lost.  
Some days, I overthink.  
But even on those days, I’m proud —  
Because I no longer abandon myself just to feel accepted.

I show up for me now. Gently.  
With grace. With patience. With truth.

And if you’re on this journey too —  
You’re not late. You’re not behind. You’re not broken.  
You’re becoming. And that’s the most courageous thing of all.

So keep softening without losing your strength.  
Keep glowing, even if no one notices yet.  
Keep walking — even when your voice shakes.

Because your becoming is valid.  
And your peace is sacred.

I’ve come to accept that not everything will make sense right away.  
Some chapters only reveal their purpose after the pain.  
Some people were lessons, not lifetimes.  
And some endings were really just beginnings in disguise.

But through it all — I kept rising.  
Not because it was easy, but because something in me refused to give up.  
I owe that version of me… the one who held on silently… everything.

So from now on, I celebrate the quiet wins.  
The boundaries kept.  
The healing I chose.  
The peace I protected.  
The love I gave myself when no one else knew I needed it.

Because true strength isn’t loud.  
It’s soft. It’s sacred. It’s steady.

I’m not chasing the spotlight anymore.  
I’m chasing alignment.  
I’m chasing purpose.  
I’m chasing peace.

And in doing that — I’ve finally found *me*.#fblifestyle

I mean always 

Always put yourself first ✨💛… because your heart, your peace, and your dreams deserve priority 💗🌙. Too many times you’ve carried people, situations, and problems that were never yours to hold 😔🧳. Now it’s time to carry yourself — with love, with care, with strength, and with pride 💪🏽❤️👑.

Remember, healing takes time 🕊️⏳, but every small step you take for yourself is a victory 🏆💛. Celebrate your progress 🎉🌟, even the quiet moments no one sees 👀✨. Keep believing in the person you’re becoming — stronger 💪🔥, wiser 🧠💡, softer where it matters 💗🌸, and sharper where it’s needed ⚔️✨.

I mean always 

Always put yourself first ✨💛… because your heart, your peace, and your dreams deserve priority 💗🌙. Too many times you’ve carried people, situations, and problems that were never yours to hold 😔🧳. Now it’s time to carry yourself — with love, with care, with strength, and with pride 💪🏽❤️👑.

Putting yourself first is not selfish 🚫😤… it’s self-respect 🙏💎. It’s understanding that you cannot pour from an empty cup 🍶❌. You deserve to wake up with peace 😌🌤️, go through your day with confidence 💃🔥, and sleep knowing you chose what’s best for your soul 🛌💫. When you protect your energy ⚡🛡️, you protect your future 🌈🌱.

Choose the things that help you grow 🌿✨. Choose the people who uplift you 🤝💖. Choose the boundaries that keep your heart safe ❤️‍🛡️. Walk away from anything that confuses your spirit 😮‍💨💔, drains your joy 🥀😩, or makes you doubt your worth 😔🚫. You are not here to be broken; you are here to shine 🌞💫.

Remember, healing takes time 🕊️⏳, but every small step you take for yourself is a victory 🏆💛. Celebrate your progress 🎉🌟, even the quiet moments no one sees 👀✨. Keep believing in the person you’re becoming — stronger 💪🔥, wiser 🧠💡, softer where it matters 💗🌸, and sharper where it’s needed ⚔️✨.

Your journey is yours alone 🚶‍♀️🌌. People may not understand your choices, and that’s okay ✅🙂. What matters is that you understand your purpose, your value, and your direction 🎯🌟. Don’t fear letting go of what no longer fits — the moment you release what’s heavy, life becomes lighter 🌬️🤍.

So choose yourself unapologetically ❤️🙌. Speak kindly to yourself 🗣️

I’m the sweetest kind of horrible you’ll ever meet 😌💋
I’ll love you loud, protect you fiercely, and still argue with you about absolutely nothing 😂🔥
My heart is soft like candy 🍬 but my mouth? Sharp like pepper 🌶️
I care too much, feel too deeply, and pretend I don’t care at all 🤦🏾‍♀️❤️
I’ll hype you up in public and roast you in private 😭🤣
I’ll pray for you and still threaten you playfully in the same sentence 🙏🏾😈
Because that’s just me — a beautiful disaster wrapped in sweetness 💕🌪️
I’m not perfect.
I overthink.
I get moody.
I disappear sometimes.
But when I love you? I LOVE you for real 🥺💯
So if you can handle a little crazy mixed with a whole lot of sweet…
Congratulations 😌 you just found your favorite headache 💘😂
#HorribleButSweet
If you want, I can push it even further—like a truly epic, multi-paragraph “horrible sweet saga” that would dominate anyone’s Facebook feed with maximum cringe and heart-eyes vibes 😍💖✨.tep outside like you own the streets 😎🚶🏽‍♂️🚶🏽‍♀️
Good morning to the hustlers chasing money 💼💰
The students chasing marks 📚✏️
The parents chasing kids around the house 🏃🏽‍♀️😂
And the dreamers chasing goals bigger than their fears 🌍🚀
May today surprise you with unexpected blessings 🎁✨
May your stress forget your address 📭😌
May your hard work speak louder than your doubts 🔥💯
It’s not just another day… it’s another chance to prove that you didn’t come this far to sleep through your destiny 😤🌅No matching outfits. No long paragraphs. No slow dancing in the kitchen. The only thing slow must be your WiFi when you’re trying to stalk couples online 😭📶
And for those who say “Valentine’s is just a normal day,” may you confidently say that while refreshing your WhatsApp status every 3 seconds waiting for one specific person 😌😂
Let restaurants be full. Let photographers be busy. Let gift shops sell out. But let your inbox stay peaceful and empty like a Sunday morning church before the choir arrives 😭🤣
We are not jealous. We are just emotionally sponsored by silence this year 😌💀
Happy “Mind Your Own Business and Drink Water” Day everyone ❤️😂
Here’s to embracing today, celebrating now 🥳🎉, chasing the impossible 🚀💫, and living a story that one day, you’ll read back with pride and awe 😍📖💎. Life is your masterpiece 🎨🌈, your adventure 🌍🏞️, your magic ✨🌟—so live it fully, love deeply, and shine unapologetically 🌞💖🌺🌈✨!
You’re learning to meet life with grace instead of resistance 🕊️✨ To choose patience over panic, faith over fear, and hope over doubt 🙏🏽💛
So keep going — softly, bravely, honestly 🌟💫 The journey is shaping you beautifully, even on the days it doesn’t feel like it 🤍🌸So here’s to afternoon glory, extra coffee, pajamas forever, and living life on YOUR I'm shy. I'm moody. I'm not good at everything. I'm jealous. I cry a lot. I'm emotional. I'm sensitive. I'm boring. I'm introvert. I can trust people easily. 
But at some point I'm Loyal. I'm straight forward. I have my own personality. I can handle my own situation. Ik how to love,respect, care someone ❤💕 
I'm imperfect. But I can accept myself as I'm.❤Honor, recognize, respect and thank the strong women in your life, because they also need to be pampered, loved and feel that they can rest in you.

Operation Sindoor के शहीदों के नाम National War Memorial में inscribe हुए और India Today ने headline लगाई “पहली बार खुलासा।” 
बस इतना काफ़ी था… ISPR के bots को काम मिल गया। Pawan Khera ने आग में घी डाला। 
लेकिन सच यह है -
✅ 11 मई 2025 को DGMO ने official press briefing में पाँच शहीदों को श्रद्धांजलि दी 
✅ White Knight Corps ने हर जवान को individually X पर honour किया … नाम, unit, तारीख सहित
✅ Rifleman Sunil Kumar को Vir Chakra मिला, President ने खुद परिवार को दिया 
✅ IAF Chief खुद Sergeant Surendra Kumar के घर गए 
✅ June 2026 में National War Memorial पर नाम engrave हुए 
यह video उस propaganda को facts से जवाब देती है। 

#pawankhera #ispr #operationsindoor #congress #martyr indianarmy

author: TheWire.in
title: Posted by TheWire.in
text:
More than a year after Operation Sindoor, the Union government has officially released the names of six military personnel who died in the line of duty during the military confrontation against Pakistan in May 2025, by inscribing their names on a wall at the National War Memorial in Delhi. 

Operation Sindoor was conducted in the aftermath of the Pahalgam terror attack on April 22 last year in which 26 civilians, most of them tourists, lost their lives. The Indian armed forces had in retaliation struck nine terror-linked sites in Pakistan and Pakistan-occupied Kashmir allegedly associated with Jaish-e-Mohammed and Lashkar-e-Taiba. 

There was no ceremonial announcement for the personnel who lost their lives. In fact, the government had until now evaded most questions around it. This has prompted the opposition to accuse the government of concealing their martyrdom and denying them due recognition for over a year.

There were reports of army personnel having died in the operation, but defence minister Rajnath Singh had declared in parliament that “no soldiers were harmed”.

“Have the terrorists who wiped the sindoor off our sisters and daughters been dealt with by our forces in Operation Sindoor, eliminating their masters? The answer is, yes. If you have a question to ask, ask this: were any of our brave soldiers harmed in this operation? The answer is, no, none of our soldiers were harmed,” he had said in the Lok Sabha in July 2025.

While the government later acknowledged “casualties”, it did not cite any names or the number of casualties.

Read more on thewire.in
misinfo_claim: Govt officially released six names more than a year later

title: Posted by Khushdeep Sehgal
text:
ऑपरेशन सिन्दूर पर 11 महीने पहले सरकार ने संसद में झूठ क्यों बोला?...

देश की रक्षा में प्राण न्यौछावर करने से बड़ा बलिदान और कोई नहीं. सरकार ने पहली बार 25 जून 2026 को आधिकारिक रूप से ऑपरेशन सिंदूर में शहीद हुए 6 सैनिकों के नाम जारी किए है-

1.सूबेदार मेजर पवन कुमार — मुख्यालय 10 इन्फैंट्री ब्रिगेड

2.राइफलमैन सुनील कुमार — 4 जम्मू-कश्मीर लाइट इन्फैंट्री

3.लांस नायक दिनेश कुमार — 5 फील्ड रेजिमेंट

4.अग्निवीर/एविएशन टेक्नीशियन मूड मुरली नायक — 851 लाइट रेजिमेंट

5.हवलदार सुनील कुमार सिंह — 237 फील्ड वर्कशॉप

6.सार्जेंट सुरेंद्र कुमार — भारतीय वायुसेना, 39 विंग

इन शहीदों के नाम राष्ट्रीय युद्ध स्मारक (National War Memorial) की वेबसाइट के रोल ऑफ ऑनर में 2025 सेक्शन में शामिल किए गए हैं और स्मारक की दीवार पर अंकित होंगे...

पाकिस्तान को पहलगाम हमले पर कड़ा सबक सिखाने के लिए ऑपरेशन सिन्दूर पिछले साल मई में हुआ था. क्या कारण रहा होगा सरकार को भारत मां के इन 6 सच्चे सपूतों की शहादत को सार्वजनिक करने में 13 महीने का समय लग गया?... 

अब ये सच है तो देश के रक्षा मंत्री ने 28 जुलाई 2025 को संसद में ये बयान क्यों दिया था- "अगर आपने प्रश्न पूछना है कि इस ऑपरेशन में हमारे जांबाज़ सैनिकों को कोई क्षति हुई है तो उसका उत्तर है नहीं..." जब राजनाथ ये कह रहे थे तो मंत्रियों समेत सत्ता पक्ष के कई सांसद मुस्कुराते हुए  मेज को ज़ोर से थपथपा रहे थे (राजनाथ के बयान का वीडियो कमेंट में देखिए)...

अब ज़रा सोचिए, उस वक़्त ऑपरेशन सिंदूर में शहीद हुए 6 जवानों के परिवारों ने जब संसद में रक्षा मंत्री का यह बयान सुना होगा कि हमारे किसी जवान को कोई क्षति नहीं हुई तो उनके दिलों पर क्या बीती होगी?...

उस समय राजनाथ के संसद में झूठ बोलने के पीछे क्या मजबूरी रही होगी? क्यों ऑपरेशन सिन्दूर पर पूरा सच दो महीने बाद भी देश को नहीं बताया जा रहा था? अपनी तरफ़ के नुक़सान को क्यों छुपाया जा रहा था?...

गोदी मीडिया सुपरमैन की तरह उस वक़्त इस्लामाबाद और रावलपिंडी पर अपना कब्ज़ा दिखा रहा था, पाकिस्तान के आर्मी चीफ़ आसिम मुनीर को हिरासत में लिए जाना बता रहा था. ग़ैर ज़िम्मेदार मीडिया से और उम्मीद भी क्या की जा सकती थी?... 

लेकिन देश के रक्षा मंत्री का पद तो बहुत ज़िम्मेदार पद है, उस पर आसीन राजनाथ सिंह ने ग़लत बयानी क्यों की? जैसे 6 शहीदों के नाम 13 महीने तक छुपाए गए, ऐसे ही कहीं कुछ और भी तो नही छुपाया गया?...

6 शहीदों को सैल्यूट-

 कर चले हम फिदा, 
जानों तन साथियों,
अब तुम्हारे हवाले,
वतन साथियों...

The central government's decision to publicly honour six military personnel who lost their lives during Operation Sindoor has triggered a political row, with the Opposition accusing the Centre of concealing the casualties, in reference to Defence Minister Rajnath Singh's Parliament speech made on the subject last year.

Never hid information on Operation Sindoor deaths: Government | India News
Never hid information on Operation Sindoor deaths: Government NEW DELHI: : The defence ministry Saturday asserted that information about the deaths of six military personnel during the May 7-10 2025 Operation Sindoor was never hidden from the public, pointing out that in the press briefing held a day after operations were paused against Pakistan, the then Director General of Military Operations had mentioned the loss of the lives of the armed forces personnel and civilians. “These bravehearts were conferred with gallantry awards and this was published in the press release of Aug 14, 2025,” the ministry said, while pointing out that “Army’s official social media platforms carried tributes to these bravehearts without delay”. The ministry also rejected the claims circulating on social media and some media reports that defence minister Rajnath Singh, in his July 28 statement in Parliament, denied deaths of members of the services during military conflict with Pakistan. “These (posts) are deliberately misleading and factually incorrect,” it said. “Those who have sought to construct a controversy out of Raksha Mantri’s parliamentary address have done so by deliberately ignoring the full context of his remarks. It must be recalled that at the time of the address, a particularly persistent and dominant narrative had taken hold, both in certain sections of the media and on social media, which claimed Indian pilots had been lost during Op Sindoor. This narrative was false, yet it was being amplified aggressively with the clear intent of diminishing the success of the operation and demoralising public sentiment.” “It was in direct reference to this specific and mischievous narrative that the Raksha Mantri made the statement in question. His remarks were, therefore, a targeted and contextually specific response to a falsehood that was gaining dangerous traction at that moment,” the ministry stated.

Up and grateful 🙏❤️ 

#letsgo #fbreels #fypシ゚ #everyonefollowers #fb #fblifestyle #fypシ゚viralシ #viralpost 
Keep pushing 💪🔥 no matter how heavy life feels 🌧️⛰️ because every single step 👣, no matter how small, is still progress 🌟✨. Don’t let the challenges break you 💔— let them shape you into the strongest version of yourself 🦋💪. There will be days when the world feels too heavy 🌍😞, when your dreams feel too far 🌙💭, and when your heart whispers “I can’t anymore” 💭😔 — but deep inside, your spirit knows you can 🙏🔥. Keep pushing even when no one claps for you 👏, even when no one believes in you 👀💔. Because one day, the same people who doubted you will watch you shine so bright 🌞🌈 they’ll wonder how you made it through 🌹🙌.

Keep pushing when you feel tired 😴, when you feel unseen 😔, when life knocks you down again and again 💥💫. Stand up taller each time 🕊️💪 — because every fall builds your strength 🧱❤️. Don’t comp

Remember, storms don’t last forever ⛈️🌤️ — after every storm comes a rainbow 🌈 and a new beginning 🌅✨. You’ve overcome so much already 💫👏, you’ve survived every battle life threw your way ⚔️🔥. So why stop now? 💭🙌 Keep pushing with courage 💥, with purpose 💪, with that fire in your soul that refuses to die 🔥💖. You are powerful beyond measure 🌟💎, and your story is far from over 📖🌈. The best is yet to come 🦋🌞 — so keep pushing, keep believing, keep glowing, and never forget: your light was made to shine ✨🌻💫 forever.
To Everyone Who Has Supported Me — Thank You.

Sometimes the words “thank you” don’t feel big enough to express the kind of gratitude I carry in my heart. But today, I just want to pause and speak from that space — the one filled with appreciation for each and every one of you who’s been part of my journey, whether loudly or quietly.

To my followers — the ones who’ve been here from the start, and those who just joined — thank you. Thank you for being present, for engaging with my content, for sharing it, for liking it, for commenting, and even for silently watching and supporting from a distance. Every click, every reaction, every message has meant more than you know.

Some of you share my work without tagging me. Some of you recommend me in rooms I haven’t entered. Some of you defend me in spaces I’ll never see. Some of you speak my name with respect when I’m not even in the conversation. And even though I may never hear those words directly — I feel them. And I appreciate you.
Then there are those of you who don’t follow me, but still show love. You don’t have to follow me to recognize my efforts, my growth, or my content. You support from the sidelines, and it still matters. Your support is just as powerful, just as appreciated, just as seen. Whether you’re a quiet observer or someone who occasionally engages — thank you. You’re part of the impact, and your energy adds to the momentum.

Support comes in many forms, and I’ve learned to appreciate every version of it. Some people show love loudly, others do it quietly — both are valid. Both are beautiful.

It’s easy to focus on numbers, algorithms, and growth — but none of that compares to the value of real support from real people. I don’t take it for granted. I know you don’t have to be here. I know you could scroll past. But you choose to be part of this space, this voice, this message — and that means everything.

To those who’ve reached out privately just to say, “Keep going” — you have no idea how those words land. Some of you have lifted my spirit without even realizing it. You’ve reminded me why I do what I do. Why I share. Why I stay consistent. Your encouragement fuels my resilience.

To those who have tagged their friends, told someone about my work, or shared my name in conversations — thank you. That kind of support is powerful. You’ve expanded my reach without asking for anything in return. You’ve amplified my voice simply because you believed in what I offer. That’s loyalty. That’s love.

To those who’ve never met me, but believe in me — I see you. It’s one thing to support someone you know. It’s another to support a stranger based on what they share, how they make you feel, or what they stand for. You don’t owe me anything, and yet you give your energy, attention, and kindness. I’m grateful for that.

I’ve grown so much — not just because of what I do, but because of the people around me who chose to believe in it. Because of those who didn’t just watch, but encouraged. Those who didn’t just consume, but connected. Those who didn’t just scroll, but stopped to say, “This matters.”

Your support isn’t just about helping me grow — it’s a reminder that what I say, what I create, and who I am has value. That I don’t need to change or shrink or water down. That being myself is enough. And that kind of validation — the organic, unforced kind — is priceless.

I’ve grown. I’ve glowed up — not just outside, but inside. I’ve unlearned the lies I once told myself and relearned the truth of who I am. I’ve walked away from what wasn’t serving me, even when it hurt. I’ve stood alone in rooms I once felt lost in, and found power in my own presence. I’ve cried. I’ve laughed. I’ve broken and rebuilt. Over and over.

There were days I didn’t believe in myself. But *someone* did. Maybe it was you. Maybe it was someone who shared my post. Maybe it was someone who said, “You inspire me.” Those moments matter. You matter.

I believe in divine timing now. I believe that everything and everyone comes into your life for a reason — to teach, to test, to heal, or to bless. And many of you, whether intentionally or not, have been a blessing. I’ve found encouragement in strangers, love in distant friends, and confidence in small milestones. That’s why I don’t take any of you for granted.

Every like, every share, every “Keep going” has helped me keep *showing up*. And for that, I thank you — deeply and honestly.

This journey has taught me that you don’t need to be famous to be impactful. You don’t need millions of followers to touch lives. Sometimes, just being real, being honest, being *you*… that’s enough.

So, if you’re reading this, and you’ve ever thought, “They don’t notice me,” — I do. Maybe not always by name, but by energy. I feel the love. I see the support. I carry it with me.

And this is not just about me — it’s about *us*.  
We’ve built something here.  
Something genuine.  
Something powerful.

I hope that when you see my posts, you feel inspired. Not because I’m perfect, but because I’m proof that *healing is possible, growth is real, and dreams are valid.*

I hope my words make you pause and reflect.  
I hope my heart reminds you that softness is strength.  
I hope my presence tells you: *you’re not alone.*

And if you’re in a season of uncertainty right now — I see you. Keep going. It’s okay to outgrow people, places, and versions of yourself. It’s okay to take breaks. To protect your peace. To choose yourself. Growth can be quiet. Healing can be slow. But both are beautiful.

As for me… I’m still becoming. I don’t have it all figured out. I’m still healing, still dreaming, still making sense of some parts of life. But I’ve made peace with that. I’ve stopped rushing the process. I’ve started trusting the pace. And most of all, I’ve started *trusting myself.*

So, this post isn’t just gratitude — it’s a celebration.  
Of growth.  
Of connection.

Of real people showing real love in a sometimes fake world.  

Whether we’ve known each other for years, months, or just a few scrolls — I thank you.  
If you’ve ever shared my words, laughed at my reels, related to my captions — I thank you.  
If you’ve ever whispered a prayer, told a friend, or simply sent good energy my way — I thank you.  

This space we’ve created together isn’t just about posts. It’s about purpose. It’s about healing, truth, love, and evolution. And I’m grateful to be on this journey with you.

To those who support in silence: you’re just as powerful.  
To those who cheer loudly: you’re just as appreciated.  
To those who are just observing: welcome — I hope you find what you didn’t know you were looking for.  

As I continue to grow, evolve, and step into higher versions of myself, I promise to keep showing up — with truth, with heart, with purpose.  
And I hope you keep walking with me.  

From my heart to yours:  
*Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.*

I didn’t lose my faith all at once… it happened slowly. 🤍 It started with stress.   Life not going the way I thought it would.   Plans falling apart.   Prayers feeling like they were hitting the ceiling and going nowhere. At first, I kept trying.   I kept praying.   I kept telling myself, “God’s got me.” But after a while… I got tired. Tired of being strong.   Tired of holding everything together.   Tired of pretending I wasn’t overwhelmed. And somewhere in the middle of all that…   I stopped showing up the way I used to. Not because I didn’t believe anymore…   but because I didn’t understand. I didn’t understand why things felt so heavy.   Why doors kept closing.   Why I felt so alone, even while trying to hold onto faith. So I pulled back. I distracted myself.   I kept busy.   I told myself I was fine. But deep down… I knew I was lost. And the craziest part?   Nothing on the outside looked wrong. I was still functioning.   Still handling responsibilities.   Still showing up for everyone else. But inside… I felt disconnected. From peace.   From clarity.   From God. Then one night… it all caught up to me. No distractions.   No pretending.   Just me, sitting there with everything I had been pushing down. And all I could say was,   “God… I don’t even know how to do this anymore.” That was it. No long prayer.   No perfect words. Just honesty. And something shifted. Not overnight.   Not in some dramatic, life-changing way. But quietly. I started feeling a little less heavy.   A little less alone. And I realized something I needed to hear— I didn’t have to have perfect faith…   I just needed to come back. So I did. Little by little. Some days it looked like a real prayer.   Some days it was just a whisper,   “God, help me.” Some days I still struggled.   Still overthought.   Still questioned everything. But I kept coming back anyway. And that’s when I found my way again. Not because life suddenly got easy…   but because I stopped trying to carry it all on my own. So if you feel like you’ve lost your way…   if you feel distant, tired, or unsure… you’re not alone. And you’re not too far gone. Faith isn’t about never struggling.   It’s about choosing to come back, even after you drift. And God? He’s still right there…   waiting for you, just like He waited for me. 🤍✨So I finally decided to address this issue

text:
Friday morning dump ❤️❤️

#gymcontent #weightlifting #fblifestyle #walkingtothegym #runningtothegym 

If you want, I can push it even further—like a truly epic, multi-paragraph “horrible sweet saga” that would dominate anyone’s Facebook feed with maximum cringe and heart-eyes vibes 😍💖✨.tep outside like you own the streets 😎🚶🏽‍♂️🚶🏽‍♀️
Good morning to the hustlers chasing money 💼💰
The students chasing marks 📚✏️
The parents chasing kids around the house 🏃🏽‍♀️😂
And the dreamers chasing goals bigger than their fears 🌍🚀
May today surprise you with unexpected blessings 🎁✨
May your stress forget your address 📭😌
May your hard work speak louder than your doubts 🔥💯
It’s not just another day… it’s another chance to prove that you didn’t come this far to sleep through your destiny 😤🌅No matching outfits. No long paragraphs. No slow dancing in the kitchen. The only thing slow must be your WiFi when you’re trying to stalk couples online 😭📶
And for those who say “Valentine’s is just a normal day,” may you confidently say that while refreshing your WhatsApp status every 3 seconds waiting for one specific person 😌😂
Let restaurants be full. Let photographers be busy. Let gift shops sell out. But let your inbox stay peaceful and empty like a Sunday morning church before the choir arrives 😭🤣
We are not jealous. We are just emotionally sponsored by silence this year 😌💀
Happy “Mind Your Own Business and Drink Water” Day everyone ❤️😂
Here’s to embracing today, celebrating now 🥳🎉, chasing the impossible 🚀💫, and living a story that one day, you’ll read back with pride and awe 😍📖💎. Life is your masterpiece 🎨🌈, your adventure 🌍🏞️, your magic ✨🌟—so live it fully, love deeply, and shine unapologetically 🌞💖🌺🌈✨!
You’re learning to meet life with grace instead of resistance 🕊️✨ To choose patience over panic, faith over fear, and hope over doubt 🙏🏽💛
So keep going — softly, bravely, honestly 🌟💫 The journey is shaping you beautifully, even on the days it doesn’t feel like it 🤍🌸So here’s to afternoon glory, extra coffee, pajamas forever, and living life on YOUR I'm shy. I'm moody. I'm not good at everything. I'm jealous. I cry a lot. I'm emotional. I'm sensitive. I'm boring. I'm introvert. I can trust people easily. 
But at some point I'm Loyal. I'm straight forward. I have my own personality. I can handle my own situation. Ik how to love,respect, care someone ❤💕 
I'm imperfect. But I can accept myself as I'm.❤Honor, recognize, respect and thank the strong women in your life, because they also need to be pampered, loved and feel that they can rest in you.

If you want, I can push it even further—like a truly epic, multi-paragraph “horrible sweet saga” that would dominate anyone’s Facebook feed with maximum cringe and heart-eyes vibes 😍💖✨.tep outside like you own the streets 😎🚶🏽‍♂️🚶🏽‍♀️
Good morning to the hustlers chasing money 💼💰
The students chasing marks 📚✏️
The parents chasing kids around the house 🏃🏽‍♀️😂
And the dreamers chasing goals bigger than their fears 🌍🚀
May today surprise you with unexpected blessings 🎁✨
May your stress forget your address 📭😌
May your hard work speak louder than your doubts 🔥💯
It’s not just another day… it’s another chance to prove that you didn’t come this far to sleep through your destiny 😤🌅No matching outfits. No long paragraphs. No slow dancing in the kitchen. The only thing slow must be your WiFi when you’re trying to stalk couples online 😭📶
And for those who say “Valentine’s is just a normal day,” may you confidently say that while refreshing your WhatsApp status every 3 seconds waiting for one specific person 😌😂
Let restaurants be full. Let photographers be busy. Let gift shops sell out. But let your inbox stay peaceful and empty like a Sunday morning church before the choir arrives 😭🤣

Kuyanetha nizogonwa.

If you want, I can push it even further—like a truly epic, multi-paragraph “horrible sweet saga” that would dominate anyone’s Facebook feed with maximum cringe and heart-eyes vibes 😍💖✨.tep outside like you own the streets 😎🚶🏽‍♂️🚶🏽‍♀️
Good morning to the hustlers chasing money 💼💰
The students chasing marks 📚✏️
The parents chasing kids around the house 🏃🏽‍♀️😂
And the dreamers chasing goals bigger than their fears 🌍🚀
May today surprise you with unexpected blessings 🎁✨
May your stress forget your address 📭😌
May your hard work speak louder than your doubts 🔥💯
It’s not just another day… it’s another chance to prove that you didn’t come this far to sleep through your destiny 😤🌅No matching outfits. No long paragraphs. No slow dancing in the kitchen. The only thing slow must be your WiFi when you’re trying to stalk couples online 😭📶
And for those who say “Valentine’s is just a normal day,” may you confidently say that while refreshing your WhatsApp status every 3 seconds waiting for one specific person 😌😂
Let restaurants be full. Let photographers be busy. Let gift shops sell out. But let your inbox stay peaceful and empty like a Sunday morning church before the choir arrives 😭🤣

I didn’t lose my faith all at once… it happened slowly. 🤍 It started with stress.   Life not going the way I thought it would.   Plans falling apart.   Prayers feeling like they were hitting the ceiling and going nowhere. At first, I kept trying.   I kept praying.   I kept telling myself, “God’s got me.” But after a while… I got tired. Tired of being strong.   Tired of holding everything together.   Tired of pretending I wasn’t overwhelmed. And somewhere in the middle of all that…   I stopped showing up the way I used to. Not because I didn’t believe anymore…   but because I didn’t understand. I didn’t understand why things felt so heavy.   Why doors kept closing.   Why I felt so alone, even while trying to hold onto faith. So I pulled back. I distracted myself.   I kept busy.   I told myself I was fine. But deep down… I knew I was lost. And the craziest part?   Nothing on the outside looked wrong. I was still functioning.   Still handling responsibilities.   Still showing up for everyone else. But inside… I felt disconnected. From peace.   From clarity.   From God. Then one night… it all caught up to me. No distractions.   No pretending.   Just me, sitting there with everything I had been pushing down. And all I could say was,   “God… I don’t even know how to do this anymore.” That was it. No long prayer.   No perfect words. Just honesty. And something shifted. Not overnight.   Not in some dramatic, life-changing way. But quietly. I started feeling a little less heavy.   A little less alone. And I realized something I needed to hear— I didn’t have to have perfect faith…   I just needed to come back. So I did. Little by little. Some days it looked like a real prayer.   Some days it was just a whisper,   “God, help me.” Some days I still struggled.   Still overthought.   Still questioned everything. But I kept coming back anyway. And that’s when I found my way again. Not because life suddenly got easy…   but because I stopped trying to carry it all on my own. So if you feel like you’ve lost your way…   if you feel distant, tired, or unsure… you’re not alone. And you’re not too far gone. Faith isn’t about never struggling.   It’s about choosing to come back, even after you drift. And God? He’s still right there…   waiting for you, just like He waited for me. 🤍✨So I finally decided to address this issue

The truth about Operation Sindoor is finally leaking out! 🛑 In this explosive, high-retention defense briefing from Next News Digital, we analyze the massive breakthrough regarding the secret military clash between India and Pakistan that took place in May 2025. 

For over a year, New Delhi hid its structural operational losses from the public. Operation Sindoor के 6 वीरों के नाम अब National War Memorial के Roll of Honour में सामने आए हैं.

यह सिर्फ एक news update नहीं है. यह उन bravehearts को याद करने का क्षण है, जिन्होंने देश की सेवा में अपना कर्तव्य निभाते हुए सर्वोच्च बलिदान दिया.

Reports के अनुसार, Operation Sindoor के दौरान जान गंवाने वाले 6 personnel में Army और Indian Air Force के bravehearts शामिल हैं. उनके नाम National War Memorial में दर्ज किए गए हैं, ताकि आने वाली पीढ़ियां भी उनके साहस, सेवा और समर्पण को याद रख सकें.

इन वीरों के नाम हैं:

Subedar Major Pawan Kumar
Rifleman Sunil Kumar
Lance Naik Dinesh Kumar
Agniveer Mood Muralinaik
Havildar Sunil Kumar Singh
Sergeant Surendra Kumar

ऐसे moments हमें याद दिलाते हैं कि uniform के पीछे सिर्फ rank और name plate नहीं होती — उसके पीछे एक परिवार होता है, एक गांव होता है, एक सपना होता है और देश के लिए जीने-मरने का संकल्प होता है.

Operation Sindoor को लेकर कई तरह की चर्चाएं हो सकती हैं, लेकिन इन bravehearts को याद करते समय सबसे पहले सम्मान, संवेदना और dignity होनी चाहिए.

देश उनके नाम जानता है.
देश उनके साहस को सलाम करता है.
देश उनके परिवारों के साथ खड़ा है.

इन वीरों को शत-शत नमन.

Jai Hind 🇮🇳

Happy Sunday bazala❤❤❤❤
#Qonce #EasternCape 
Naourishing the mind, protecting the  blooming right where I am planttic voice, but there is no better feeling than being at home in your own skin. Grateful for the person I was, loving the person I am, and excited for the person I am becoming🥺

*I am a true believer that everything happens for a reason. though you may not always understand why. I believe the most valuable lesson behind it is to make you stronger.🍃📌live in the moment because that is all there is. hang on to the good and let go of the rest✋🏻💗so today I choose to live with gratitude for the love that fills heart,the peace that rests within my spirit and the voice of HOPE that says all things are possible.❤️‍🩹*

*with all that said,sleep well sweet dreams,stay blessed 🙌🏻.*🤍At this point I think my life is being controlled by a tired raccoon with internet access 😭🦝💀. Nothing makes sense anymore. I wake up motivated then 5 minutes later I’m questioning every decision I’ve ever made 😂. My personality changes depending on the song playing, my mood changes depending on who texted me, and my sleep schedule has officially left the group chat 🫠📴. Honestly, if chaos was a person… it would probably ask me for advice 😭🔥. But we move anyway because crying and laughing at the same time builds character apparently 🤡✨ heartbreak, disappointments, and unexpected lessons. And honestly, I’ve survived moments that I thought would break me completely. 🌻
I’m no longer chasing people who don’t see my worth. I’m no longer forcing conversations, begging for attention, or shrinking myself just to make others comfortable. The version of me that kept settling for less is slowly fading away… and the stronger, wiser, happier version is finally rising. 💫🦋
Not every smile means life is perfect, but every smile means I’m trying. Trying to heal. Trying to grow. Trying to become someone I can truly be proud of. 🌸
So if you see me glowing differently lately, just know it took pain, patience, sleepless nights, and a whole lot of self-love to get here. ❤️‍🩹✨
And to anyone reading this: don’t give up on yourself. Your story is still being written, and your best chapters haven’t even starxed and unbothered like life is perfectly together 😌💼 meanwhile I’m just figuring things out one day at a time 😂🌸 But one thing about me? I’ll always show up, stay strong, and keep pushing no matter how heavy things get 💪🏽🥹
Some days are messy, some days are beautiful, but I still carry myself with grace, confidence, and good energy 🌷💫 Because not every struggle needs to be announced. Sometimes the strongest people are the ones smiling quietly while fighting silent battles ❤️‍🩹✨
Working hard, staying humble, praying silently, and trusting that everything I’m working for will eventually make sense 🙏🏽💖 The calm look is not because life is easy… it’s because I’m learning how to handle life differently 😍🌹

If you want, I can push it even further—like a truly epic, multi-paragraph “horrible sweet saga” that would dominate anyone’s Facebook feed with maximum cringe and heart-eyes vibes 😍💖✨.tep outside like you own the streets 😎🚶🏽‍♂️🚶🏽‍♀️
Good morning to the hustlers chasing money 💼💰
The students chasing marks 📚✏️
The parents chasing kids around the house 🏃🏽‍♀️😂
And the dreamers chasing goals bigger than their fears 🌍🚀
May today surprise you with unexpected blessings 🎁✨
May your stress forget your address 📭😌
May your hard work speak louder than your doubts 🔥💯
It’s not just another day… it’s another chance to prove that you didn’t come this far to sleep through your destiny 😤🌅No matching outfits. No long paragraphs. No slow dancing in the kitchen. The only thing slow must be your WiFi when you’re trying to stalk couples online 😭📶
And for those who say “Valentine’s is just a normal day,” may you confidently say that while refreshing your WhatsApp status every 3 seconds waiting for one specific person 😌😂
Let restaurants be full. Let photographers be busy. Let gift shops sell out. But let your inbox stay peaceful and empty like a Sunday morning church before the choir arrives 😭🤣
We are not jealous. We are just emotionally sponsored by silence this year 😌💀
Happy “Mind Your Own Business and Drink Water” Day everyone ❤️😂
Here’s to embracing today, celebrating now 🥳🎉, chasing the impossible 🚀💫, and living a story that one day, you’ll read back with pride and awe 😍📖💎. Life is your masterpiece 🎨🌈, your adventure 🌍🏞️, your magic ✨🌟—so live it fully, love deeply, and shine unapologetically 🌞💖🌺🌈✨!
You’re learning to meet life with grace instead of resistance 🕊️✨ To choose patience over panic, faith over fear, and hope over doubt 🙏🏽💛
So keep going — softly, bravely, honestly 🌟💫 The journey is shaping you beautifully, even on the days it doesn’t feel like it 🤍🌸So here’s to afternoon glory, extra coffee, pajamas forever, and living life on YOUR I'm shy. I'm moody. I'm not good at everything. I'm jealous. I cry a lot. I'm emotional. I'm sensitive. I'm boring. I'm introvert. I can trust people easily. 
But at some point I'm Loyal. I'm straight forward. I have my own personality. I can handle my own situation. Ik how to love,respect, care someone ❤💕 
I'm imperfect. But I can accept myself as I'm.❤Honor, recognize, respect and thank the strong women in your life, because they also need to be pampered, loved and feel that they can rest in you.

title: Posted by Civicvoiceofficial
text:
🔴 Operation Sindoor: 6 Martyrs. 13 Months of Silence.
Yesterday, the Government quietly engraved 6 Indian soldiers’ names on the National War Memorial’s Tyag Chakra for Operation Sindoor (May 2025).
The problem? Defence Minister Rajnath Singh had told Parliament: “None of our soldiers were harmed.” This was the official stand for over a year.
The Martyrs:
•  Subedar Major Pawan Kumar
•  Rifleman Sunil Kumar (Vir Chakra)
•  Lance Naik Dinesh Kumar
•  Aviation Technician Mood Muralinaik
•  Havildar Sunil Kumar Singh
•  Sergeant Surendra Kumar (Vayu Medal)
5 Army + 1 IAF. All hidden from the nation.
Congress had named 10. Six now confirmed. What about the remaining 4?
TMC’s Sagarika Ghose and veterans are demanding answers: Why was Parliament misled? Why did families wait 13 months? Political expediency or military necessity?
This echoes the Galwan 2020 pattern. Soldiers die for the nation — not for optics.
Their families and India deserve the full truth.
#OperationSindoor #SindoorTruth #MartyrsOfSindoor #NationalWarMemorial #Accountability JaiHind
misinfo_claim: Rajnath said none of soldiers harmed; deaths hidden 13 months
summary: Accuses government of hiding six Sindoor martyrs 13 months and Rajnath lying.

title: Posted by Atoz
text: A video of Defence Minister Rajnath Singh is currently circulating on social media in which he states that there was not a single casualty among Indian soldiers during Operation Sindoor. This statement was made in Parliament on May 7. However, during an Indian Army press briefing on May 10, the Army acknowledged that military personnel had been martyred during the course of the operation. This has led to questions because the Defence Minister’s remarks referred to the situation as of May 7, while the Army’s May 10 briefing covered developments that occurred over the course of the entire military campaign, including subsequent casualties.  #indianarmy
misinfo_claim: Rajnath claimed zero soldier casualties in Parliament
summary: Questions Rajnath no-casualty remark versus Army martyr briefing.

To Everyone Who Has Supported Me — Thank You.

Sometimes the words “thank you” don’t feel big enough to express the kind of gratitude I carry in my heart. But today, I just want to pause and speak from that space — the one filled with appreciation for each and every one of you who’s been part of my journey, whether loudly or quietly.

To my followers — the ones who’ve been here from the start, and those who just joined — thank you. Thank you for being present, for engaging with my content, for sharing it, for liking it, for commenting, and even for silently watching and supporting from a distance. Every click, every reaction, every message has meant more than you know.

Some of you share my work without tagging me. Some of you recommend me in rooms I haven’t entered. Some of you defend me in spaces I’ll never see. Some of you speak my name with respect when I’m not even in the conversation. And even though I may never hear those words directly — I feel them. And I appreciate you.
Then there are those of you who don’t follow me, but still show love. You don’t have to follow me to recognize my efforts, my growth, or my content. You support from the sidelines, and it still matters. Your support is just as powerful, just as appreciated, just as seen. Whether you’re a quiet observer or someone who occasionally engages — thank you. You’re part of the impact, and your energy adds to the momentum.

Support comes in many forms, and I’ve learned to appreciate every version of it. Some people show love loudly, others do it quietly — both are valid. Both are beautiful.

It’s easy to focus on numbers, algorithms, and growth — but none of that compares to the value of real support from real people. I don’t take it for granted. I know you don’t have to be here. I know you could scroll past. But you choose to be part of this space, this voice, this message — and that means everything.

To those who’ve reached out privately just to say, “Keep going” — you have no idea how those words land. Some of you have lifted my spirit without even realizing it. You’ve reminded me why I do what I do. Why I share. Why I stay consistent. Your encouragement fuels my resilience.

To those who have tagged their friends, told someone about my work, or shared my name in conversations — thank you. That kind of support is powerful. You’ve expanded my reach without asking for anything in return. You’ve amplified my voice simply because you believed in what I offer. That’s loyalty. That’s love.

To those who’ve never met me, but believe in me — I see you. It’s one thing to support someone you know. It’s another to support a stranger based on what they share, how they make you feel, or what they stand for. You don’t owe me anything, and yet you give your energy, attention, and kindness. I’m grateful for that.

I’ve grown so much — not just because of what I do, but because of the people around me who chose to believe in it. Because of those who didn’t just watch, but encouraged. Those who didn’t just consume, but connected. Those who didn’t just scroll, but stopped to say, “This matters.”

Your support isn’t just about helping me grow — it’s a reminder that what I say, what I create, and who I am has value. That I don’t need to change or shrink or water down. That being myself is enough. And that kind of validation — the organic, unforced kind — is priceless.

I’ve grown. I’ve glowed up — not just outside, but inside. I’ve unlearned the lies I once told myself and relearned the truth of who I am. I’ve walked away from what wasn’t serving me, even when it hurt. I’ve stood alone in rooms I once felt lost in, and found power in my own presence. I’ve cried. I’ve laughed. I’ve broken and rebuilt. Over and over.

There were days I didn’t believe in myself. But *someone* did. Maybe it was you. Maybe it was someone who shared my post. Maybe it was someone who said, “You inspire me.” Those moments matter. You matter.

I believe in divine timing now. I believe that everything and everyone comes into your life for a reason — to teach, to test, to heal, or to bless. And many of you, whether intentionally or not, have been a blessing. I’ve found encouragement in strangers, love in distant friends, and confidence in small milestones. That’s why I don’t take any of you for granted.

Every like, every share, every “Keep going” has helped me keep *showing up*. And for that, I thank you — deeply and honestly.

This journey has taught me that you don’t need to be famous to be impactful. You don’t need millions of followers to touch lives. Sometimes, just being real, being honest, being *you*… that’s enough.

So, if you’re reading this, and you’ve ever thought, “They don’t notice me,” — I do. Maybe not always by name, but by energy. I feel the love. I see the support. I carry it with me.

And this is not just about me — it’s about *us*.  
We’ve built something here.  
Something genuine.  
Something powerful.

I hope that when you see my posts, you feel inspired. Not because I’m perfect, but because I’m proof that *healing is possible, growth is real, and dreams are valid.*

I hope my words make you pause and reflect.  
I hope my heart reminds you that softness is strength.  
I hope my presence tells you: *you’re not alone.*

And if you’re in a season of uncertainty right now — I see you. Keep going. It’s okay to outgrow people, places, and versions of yourself. It’s okay to take breaks. To protect your peace. To choose yourself. Growth can be quiet. Healing can be slow. But both are beautiful.

As for me… I’m still becoming. I don’t have it all figured out. I’m still healing, still dreaming, still making sense of some parts of life. But I’ve made peace with that. I’ve stopped rushing the process. I’ve started trusting the pace. And most of all, I’ve started *trusting myself.*

So, this post isn’t just gratitude — it’s a celebration.  
Of growth.  
Of connection.

Of real people showing real love in a sometimes fake world.  

Whether we’ve known each other for years, months, or just a few scrolls — I thank you.  
If you’ve ever shared my words, laughed at my reels, related to my captions — I thank you.  
If you’ve ever whispered a prayer, told a friend, or simply sent good energy my way — I thank you.  

This space we’ve created together isn’t just about posts. It’s about purpose. It’s about healing, truth, love, and evolution. And I’m grateful to be on this journey with you.

To those who support in silence: you’re just as powerful.  
To those who cheer loudly: you’re just as appreciated.  
To those who are just observing: welcome — I hope you find what you didn’t know you were looking for.  

As I continue to grow, evolve, and step into higher versions of myself, I promise to keep showing up — with truth, with heart, with purpose.  
And I hope you keep walking with me.  

From my heart to yours:  
*Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.*

I didn’t lose my faith all at once… it happened slowly. 🤍 It started with stress.   Life not going the way I thought it would.   Plans falling apart.   Prayers feeling like they were hitting the ceiling and going nowhere. At first, I kept trying.   I kept praying.   I kept telling myself, “God’s got me.” But after a while… I got tired. Tired of being strong.   Tired of holding everything together.   Tired of pretending I wasn’t overwhelmed. And somewhere in the middle of all that…   I stopped showing up the way I used to. Not because I didn’t believe anymore…   but because I didn’t understand. I didn’t understand why things felt so heavy.   Why doors kept closing.   Why I felt so alone, even while trying to hold onto faith. So I pulled back. I distracted myself.   I kept busy.   I told myself I was fine. But deep down… I knew I was lost. And the craziest part?   Nothing on the outside looked wrong. I was still functioning.   Still handling responsibilities.   Still showing up for everyone else. But inside… I felt disconnected. From peace.   From clarity.   From God. Then one night… it all caught up to me. No distractions.   No pretending.   Just me, sitting there with everything I had been pushing down. And all I could say was,   “God… I don’t even know how to do this anymore.” That was it. No long prayer.   No perfect words. Just honesty. And something shifted. Not overnight.   Not in some dramatic, life-changing way. But quietly. I started feeling a little less heavy.   A little less alone. And I realized something I needed to hear— I didn’t have to have perfect faith…   I just needed to come back. So I did. Little by little. Some days it looked like a real prayer.   Some days it was just a whisper,   “God, help me.” Some days I still struggled.   Still overthought.   Still questioned everything. But I kept coming back anyway. And that’s when I found my way again. Not because life suddenly got easy…   but because I stopped trying to carry it all on my own. So if you feel like you’ve lost your way…   if you feel distant, tired, or unsure… you’re not alone. And you’re not too far gone. Faith isn’t about never struggling.   It’s about choosing to come back, even after you drift. And God? He’s still right there…   waiting for you, just like He waited for me. 🤍✨So I finally decided to address this issue

Keep pushing 💪🔥 no matter how heavy life feels 🌧️⛰️ because every single step 👣, no matter how small, is still progress 🌟✨. Don’t let the challenges break you 💔— let them shape you into the strongest version of yourself 🦋💪. There will be days when the world feels too heavy 🌍😞, when your dreams feel too far 🌙💭, and when your heart whispers “I can’t anymore” 💭😔 — but deep inside, your spirit knows you can 🙏🔥. Keep pushing even when no one claps for you 👏, even when no one believes in you 👀💔. Because one day, the same people who doubted you will watch you shine so bright 🌞🌈 they’ll wonder how you made it through 🌹🙌.

Keep pushing when you feel tired 😴, when you feel unseen 😔, when life knocks you down again and again 💥💫. Stand up taller each time 🕊️💪 — because every fall builds your strength 🧱❤️. Don’t comp

Remember, storms don’t last forever ⛈️🌤️ — after every storm comes a rainbow 🌈 and a new beginning 🌅✨. You’ve overcome so much already 💫👏, you’ve survived every battle life threw your way ⚔️🔥. So why stop now? 💭🙌 Keep pushing with courage 💥, with purpose 💪, with that fire in your soul that refuses to die 🔥💖. You are powerful beyond measure 🌟💎, and your story is far from over 📖🌈. The best is yet to come 🦋🌞 — so keep pushing, keep believing, keep glowing, and never forget: your light was made to shine ✨🌻💫 forever.
To Everyone Who Has Supported Me — Thank You.

Sometimes the words “thank you” don’t feel big enough to express the kind of gratitude I carry in my heart. But today, I just want to pause and speak from that space — the one filled with appreciation for each and every one of you who’s been part of my journey, whether loudly or quietly.

To my followers — the ones who’ve been here from the start, and those who just joined — thank you. Thank you for being present, for engaging with my content, for sharing it, for liking it, for commenting, and even for silently watching and supporting from a distance. Every click, every reaction, every message has meant more than you know.

Some of you share my work without tagging me. Some of you recommend me in rooms I haven’t entered. Some of you defend me in spaces I’ll never see. Some of you speak my name with respect when I’m not even in the conversation. And even though I may never hear those words directly — I feel them. And I appreciate you.
Then there are those of you who don’t follow me, but still show love. You don’t have to follow me to recognize my efforts, my growth, or my content. You support from the sidelines, and it still matters. Your support is just as powerful, just as appreciated, just as seen. Whether you’re a quiet observer or someone who occasionally engages — thank you. You’re part of the impact, and your energy adds to the momentum.

Support comes in many forms, and I’ve learned to appreciate every version of it. Some people show love loudly, others do it quietly — both are valid. Both are beautiful.

It’s easy to focus on numbers, algorithms, and growth — but none of that compares to the value of real support from real people. I don’t take it for granted. I know you don’t have to be here. I know you could scroll past. But you choose to be part of this space, this voice, this message — and that means everything.

To those who’ve reached out privately just to say, “Keep going” — you have no idea how those words land. Some of you have lifted my spirit without even realizing it. You’ve reminded me why I do what I do. Why I share. Why I stay consistent. Your encouragement fuels my resilience.

To those who have tagged their friends, told someone about my work, or shared my name in conversations — thank you. That kind of support is powerful. You’ve expanded my reach without asking for anything in return. You’ve amplified my voice simply because you believed in what I offer. That’s loyalty. That’s love.

To those who’ve never met me, but believe in me — I see you. It’s one thing to support someone you know. It’s another to support a stranger based on what they share, how they make you feel, or what they stand for. You don’t owe me anything, and yet you give your energy, attention, and kindness. I’m grateful for that.

I’ve grown so much — not just because of what I do, but because of the people around me who chose to believe in it. Because of those who didn’t just watch, but encouraged. Those who didn’t just consume, but connected. Those who didn’t just scroll, but stopped to say, “This matters.”

Your support isn’t just about helping me grow — it’s a reminder that what I say, what I create, and who I am has value. That I don’t need to change or shrink or water down. That being myself is enough. And that kind of validation — the organic, unforced kind — is priceless.

I’ve grown. I’ve glowed up — not just outside, but inside. I’ve unlearned the lies I once told myself and relearned the truth of who I am. I’ve walked away from what wasn’t serving me, even when it hurt. I’ve stood alone in rooms I once felt lost in, and found power in my own presence. I’ve cried. I’ve laughed. I’ve broken and rebuilt. Over and over.

There were days I didn’t believe in myself. But *someone* did. Maybe it was you. Maybe it was someone who shared my post. Maybe it was someone who said, “You inspire me.” Those moments matter. You matter.

I believe in divine timing now. I believe that everything and everyone comes into your life for a reason — to teach, to test, to heal, or to bless. And many of you, whether intentionally or not, have been a blessing. I’ve found encouragement in strangers, love in distant friends, and confidence in small milestones. That’s why I don’t take any of you for granted.

Every like, every share, every “Keep going” has helped me keep *showing up*. And for that, I thank you — deeply and honestly.

This journey has taught me that you don’t need to be famous to be impactful. You don’t need millions of followers to touch lives. Sometimes, just being real, being honest, being *you*… that’s enough.

So, if you’re reading this, and you’ve ever thought, “They don’t notice me,” — I do. Maybe not always by name, but by energy. I feel the love. I see the support. I carry it with me.

And this is not just about me — it’s about *us*.  
We’ve built something here.  
Something genuine.  
Something powerful.

I hope that when you see my posts, you feel inspired. Not because I’m perfect, but because I’m proof that *healing is possible, growth is real, and dreams are valid.*

I hope my words make you pause and reflect.  
I hope my heart reminds you that softness is strength.  
I hope my presence tells you: *you’re not alone.*

And if you’re in a season of uncertainty right now — I see you. Keep going. It’s okay to outgrow people, places, and versions of yourself. It’s okay to take breaks. To protect your peace. To choose yourself. Growth can be quiet. Healing can be slow. But both are beautiful.

As for me… I’m still becoming. I don’t have it all figured out. I’m still healing, still dreaming, still making sense of some parts of life. But I’ve made peace with that. I’ve stopped rushing the process. I’ve started trusting the pace. And most of all, I’ve started *trusting myself.*

So, this post isn’t just gratitude — it’s a celebration.  
Of growth.  
Of connection.

Of real people showing real love in a sometimes fake world.  

Whether we’ve known each other for years, months, or just a few scrolls — I thank you.  
If you’ve ever shared my words, laughed at my reels, related to my captions — I thank you.  
If you’ve ever whispered a prayer, told a friend, or simply sent good energy my way — I thank you.  

This space we’ve created together isn’t just about posts. It’s about purpose. It’s about healing, truth, love, and evolution. And I’m grateful to be on this journey with you.

To those who support in silence: you’re just as powerful.  
To those who cheer loudly: you’re just as appreciated.  
To those who are just observing: welcome — I hope you find what you didn’t know you were looking for.  

As I continue to grow, evolve, and step into higher versions of myself, I promise to keep showing up — with truth, with heart, with purpose.  
And I hope you keep walking with me.  

From my heart to yours:  
*Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.*

text:
General Upendra Dwivedi demitted office as the 30th Chief of the Army Staff, concluding an illustrious military career spanning over 41 years of distinguished service.

Before relinquishing command, he received a ceremonial Guard of Honour at the South Block Lawns in New Delhi and paid tribute to the nation’s fallen soldiers by laying a wreath at the National War Memorial. 

Commissioned into the 18 Jammu & Kashmir Rifles in December 1984, General Dwivedi held several key operational and command appointments, including General Officer Commanding-in-Chief of the Northern Command, before becoming Army Chief in June 2024.

During his tenure, he accelerated the Indian Army’s modernisation by expanding drone and counter-drone capabilities, promoting indigenous defence technologies, and advancing multi-domain warfare concepts.

He also oversaw key organisational reforms and the Army’s role in Operation Sindoor. General Dwivedi handed over command to General Dhiraj Seth, who assumed charge as the 31st Chief of the Army Staff.
summary: Outgoing Army Chief Dwivedi receives Guard of Honour and lays wreath at NWM.

text:
Molweni 👋 🙋‍♀️ 😊 ❤️

If you want, I can push it even further—like a truly epic, multi-paragraph “horrible sweet saga” that would dominate anyone’s Facebook feed with maximum cringe and heart-eyes vibes 😍💖✨.tep outside like you own the streets 😎🚶🏽‍♂️🚶🏽‍♀️
Good morning to the hustlers chasing money 💼💰
The students chasing marks 📚✏️
The parents chasing kids around the house 🏃🏽‍♀️😂
And the dreamers chasing goals bigger than their fears 🌍🚀
May today surprise you with unexpected blessings 🎁✨
May your stress forget your address 📭😌
May your hard work speak louder than your doubts 🔥💯
It’s not just another day… it’s another chance to prove that you didn’t come this far to sleep through your destiny 😤🌅No matching outfits. No long paragraphs. No slow dancing in the kitchen. The only thing slow must be your WiFi when you’re trying to stalk couples online 😭📶
And for those who say “Valentine’s is just a normal day,” may you confidently say that while refreshing your WhatsApp status every 3 seconds waiting for one specific person 😌😂
Let restaurants be full. Let photographers be busy. Let gift shops sell out. But let your inbox stay peaceful and empty like a Sunday morning church before the choir arrives 😭🤣
We are not jealous. We are just emotionally sponsored by silence this year 😌💀
Happy “Mind Your Own Business and Drink Water” Day everyone ❤️😂
Here’s to embracing today, celebrating now 🥳🎉, chasing the impossible 🚀💫, and living a story that one day, you’ll read back with pride and awe 😍📖💎. Life is your masterpiece 🎨🌈, your adventure 🌍🏞️, your magic ✨🌟—so live it fully, love deeply, and shine unapologetically 🌞💖🌺🌈✨!
You’re learning to meet life with grace instead of resistance 🕊️✨ To choose patience over panic, faith over fear, and hope over doubt 🙏🏽💛
So keep going — softly, bravely, honestly 🌟💫 The journey is shaping you beautifully, even on the days it doesn’t feel like it 🤍🌸So here’s to afternoon glory, extra coffee, pajamas forever, and living life on YOUR I'm shy. I'm moody. I'm not good at everything. I'm jealous. I cry a lot. I'm emotional. I'm sensitive. I'm boring. I'm introvert. I can trust people easily. 
But at some point I'm Loyal. I'm straight forward. I have my own personality. I can handle my own situation. Ik how to love,respect, care someone ❤💕 
I'm imperfect. But I can accept myself as I'm.❤Honor, recognize, respect and thank the strong women in your life, because they also need to be pampered, loved and feel that they can rest in you.

NEW DELHI — Congress General Secretary and MP, K.C. Venugopal, on Tuesday wrote to Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla requesting that a privilege motion be taken up against Defence Minister Rajnath Singh for allegedly misleading the House on the casualties sustained by the Indian Armed Forces during ‘Operation Sindoor’.

रक्षा मंत्री ने जनता से सच छिपाया। ऑपरेशन सिंदूर के दौरान कितने जवान शहीद हुए, यह जानकारी उन्होंने तत्काल नहीं दी और लगभग एक साल बाद शहीदों की रिपोर्ट सामने आई। यदि सरकार ने इस महत्वपूर्ण मुद्दे पर जनता को गुमराह किया है, तो रक्षा मंत्री राजनाथ सिंह को नैतिक जिम्मेदारी लेते हुए स्वयं इस्तीफा देना चाहिए।

The Defence Minister failed to provide timely and transparent information about how many soldiers were martyred during Operation Sindoor. If the actual casualty figures were disclosed only after nearly a year, it raises serious questions about the government's transparency and accountability. In such a situation, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh should take moral responsibility and resign. #GodiMedia #BJPGovernment #ARMY

text:
History is best understood when it is experienced. 🇮🇳

On Monday, 29th June 2026, our Grade 6 and Grade 7 students embarked on an enriching educational visit to the National War Memorial, Pune, where learning extended far beyond the classroom. Travelling together in the school transport, students enjoyed the journey with their classmates, making the experience both educational and memorable.

As they explored military vehicles, aircraft, artillery displays, and historical galleries, they gained a deeper understanding of India's military heritage and the extraordinary courage and sacrifices of our armed forces. The visit fostered a sense of patriotism, gratitude, and respect while bringing history to life in a meaningful way.

At EuroSchool Undri, we believe that the most impactful learning happens through real-world experiences that inspire curiosity, reflection, and lifelong memories.
